title: Yeti Summit Series Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Banana Ice from Yeti’s Summit collection combines the sweet, creamy flavour of ripe Bananas with the cool, refreshing touch of menthol. This e-liquid provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience, perfect for those who enjoy fruity flavours with an icy twist. Achieve the ideal balance of flavour, vapour, and throat hit with this premium e-liquid's 50VG/50PG blend. This nic salt e-liquid is perfect for use with classic starter vape kits and pod vape devices. The nicotine salt solution ensures a swift and satisfying nicotine relief, making Yeti Nic Salts an effective alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love intensely flavourful and incredibly icy e-liquids, then the Summit Series by Yeti E-Liquid is set to become your new favourite. This exciting collection offers 15 double-concentrated flavours, each packed with that arctic icy freshness that Yeti is renowned for. Available in convenient 10ml bottles with varying nicotine strengths, the Summit Series allows you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to single-use disposable vapes. Best used with Starter Vape kits, Pod Kits and low-resistance vape devices
